takeaways: The tutorial is a Python roguelike tutorial, with a current version and an older libtcod (TCOD) version.
Help is available through the Roguelike Development subreddit and a linked Discord channel.
The original Python and libtcod tutorial is hosted on Roguebasin.
The author (username TStand90) invites direct messages to report problems in the tutorial.
summary.summary: This is the landing page for the Roguelike Tutorial Revised, a Python tutorial for making a roguelike game. The page links to the current version of the tutorial and to the older libtcod (TCOD) version, and it notes that the original Python and libtcod tutorial is on Roguebasin. It points readers to the Roguelike Development subreddit and its Discord channel for help, and it gives the author's username for reporting problems. The page itself is short and navigational, so details of the lessons are not included in the text provided.
